segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Kathryn and today we have a very, very useful intermediate level lesson for you all about the weather.
segments.zh: 我的名字是 Kathryn，今天我们为大家准备了一个非常非常有用的中级课程，让大家了解天气。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So obviously we have seen the news and sometimes on the news we have the weather report.
segments.zh: 很明显，我们已经看到了新闻，有时在新闻上我们有天气报告。

segments.en: So today we're going to learn all about that weather report in English.
segments.zh: 所以今天我们将用英语了解有关该天气报告的所有信息。

segments.en: So let's check out today's dialogue and we'll be back in a moment to talk about the words and phrases that those weather forecasters used.
segments.zh: 所以让我们看看今天的对话，我们稍后会回来谈论那些天气预报员使用的单词和短语。

segments.en: And those are today's top stories.
segments.zh: 这些是今天的头条新闻。

segments.en: Now let's go to John for the weather.
segments.zh: 接下来请约翰播报天气。

segments.en: John, what does the forecast look like for our weekend travelers?
segments.zh: 约翰，打算周末出游的人会遇上什么天气？

segments.en: I'm afraid we're in for a rough weekend, Mary.
segments.zh: 恐怕我们要度过一个艰难的周末，玛丽。

segments.en: There's a storm system moving through the East Coast.
segments.zh: 有一个风暴系统在东海岸移动。

segments.en: It will be drizzling all day today and there's a 60% chance of thunderstorms this evening.
segments.zh: 今天一整天都会下毛毛雨，今晚有 60% 的可能性出现雷暴。

segments.en: It will be warm and humid all weekend.
segments.zh: 整个周末都会温暖潮湿。

segments.en: In the Midwest, expect strong winds and a low of around 40 degrees.
segments.zh: 中西部地区预计有强风，最低气温在四十度左右。

segments.en: That's pretty chilly for the summer.
segments.zh: 这对夏天来说很冷。

segments.en: Will it rain on Saturday?
segments.zh: 周六会下雨吗？

segments.en: Unfortunately, yes.
segments.zh: 很遗憾，是的。

segments.en: It will be clear early Saturday morning, but there is a high chance of showers and thunderstorms later in the day.
segments.zh: 星期六清晨天气晴朗，但当天晚些时候很可能有阵雨和雷暴。

segments.en: There is a severe thunderstorm warning for some parts of the Southeast.
segments.zh: 东南部的一些地区有严重的雷暴警告。

segments.en: Folks in those areas might see some hail and flooding, especially in areas that have been experiencing record high rainfalls.
segments.zh: 这些地区的人们可能会看到一些冰雹和洪水，尤其是在降雨量创历史新高的地区。

segments.en: That certainly sounds like a dreary Saturday.
segments.zh: 这听起来肯定是一个沉闷的星期六。

segments.en: It gets better on Sunday, though.
segments.zh: 不过，周日会好转。

segments.en: The storm systems move east and the skies will clear up at night.
segments.zh: 风暴系统向东移动，天空将在夜晚晴朗。

segments.en: It will still be rather cool with highs in the low 50s.
segments.zh: 天气仍会比较凉，最高气温在五十度出头。

segments.en: The West Coast will be experiencing some unusually chilly weather, but at least the sun will come out.
segments.zh: 西海岸将经历一些异常寒冷的天气，但至少太阳会出来。

segments.en: I advise weekend travelers to be careful, especially while driving.
segments.zh: 我建议周末旅行者要小心，尤其是在开车时。

segments.en: Back to you, Mary.
segments.zh: 接下来交还给你，玛丽。

segments.en: Thanks, John.
segments.zh: 谢谢，约翰。

segments.en: And there you have it.
segments.zh: 以上就是天气情况。

segments.en: Looks like it's a weekend to stay at home.
segments.zh: 看起来这是一个呆在家里的周末。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So apparently, they're not going to have great weather this weekend and they actually started with an interesting word.
segments.zh: 所以显然，他们这个周末不会有好天气，他们实际上是从一个有趣的词开始的。

segments.en: And actually, the commentator started with asking the weatherman, John, what does the forecast look like for our weekend?
segments.zh: 实际上，评论员开始问天气预报员约翰，我们周末的预测是什么样的？

segments.en: Okay, so the word here, forecast, is very, very important because it describes this part of the newscast.
segments.zh: 好吧，这里的词，预测，非常非常重要，因为它描述了新闻广播的这一部分。

segments.en: A forecast is basically a prediction or a description of the future weather situation.
segments.zh: 预报基本上是对未来天气情况的预测或描述。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we're talking about the weather forecast.
segments.zh: 所以我们谈论的是天气预报。

segments.en: Now it's very interesting because we can also use that in business, for example, in budgets.
segments.zh: 现在这很有趣，因为我们也可以在商业中使用它，例如在预算中。

segments.en: You can say, what is the financial forecast of the company?
segments.zh: 可以说，公司的财务预测是什么？

segments.en: All right, so you can't know what will happen, but you can predict it and that's what a forecast is.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以你不知道会发生什么，但你可以预测它，这就是预测。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we're talking about the weather forecast and the weatherman said that, well, there are some storms coming and it will be drizzling all day.
segments.zh: 所以我们谈论的是天气预报，天气预报员说，好吧，有一些风暴即将到来，一整天都会下着毛毛雨。

segments.en: Okay, so to drizzle is a verb and it's like the verb to rain, except it's less by degree.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以 drizzle 是一个动词，和动词 rain 类似，只是程度更轻。

segments.en: So it's very light rain.
segments.zh: 所以这是非常小的雨。

segments.en: Yeah, it's kind of like if I spray you with water from a spray can or something, it's like drizzle.
segments.zh: 是的，这有点像我用喷雾罐或其他东西喷水，就像毛毛雨一样。

segments.en: It's just little dots of water.
segments.zh: 这只是小点水。

segments.en: It's not like you're getting wet.
segments.zh: 这不像你被弄湿了。

segments.en: You don't really have the normal heavy raindrops.
segments.zh: 你真的没有正常的大雨滴。

segments.en: You just have a little bit of water coming down.
segments.zh: 只是有一点点水落下来。

segments.en: But it's annoying because do you bring your umbrella?
segments.zh: 但这很烦人，因为你不知道该不该带伞。

segments.en: Do you leave your umbrella?
segments.zh: 还是把伞留在家里？

segments.en: So drizzling is a kind of rain that's very, very light.
segments.zh: 所以毛毛雨是一种非常非常轻的雨。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: All right, so it's going to drizzle all day and the weatherman also said that we might have some thunderstorms.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以今天会下一整天毛毛雨，天气预报员还说可能会有雷暴。

segments.en: Okay, so thunderstorms are very different.
segments.zh: 好的，所以雷暴是非常不同的。

segments.en: Thunderstorms are a kind of storm where there is thunder.
segments.zh: 雷暴是一种有雷声的风暴。

segments.en: So thunder is the loud noises when there's lightning.
segments.zh: 所以雷声是有闪电时的巨响。

segments.en: Lightning, okay.
segments.zh: 闪电，好吧。

segments.en: So lightning is like the flash that you get from the sky and thunder is the hard sound that comes after.
segments.zh: 所以闪电就像天空中闪过的光，雷声是紧随其后的巨大响声。

segments.en: The boom.
segments.zh: 轰的一声。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Yeah, so remember light, lightning.
segments.zh: 是的，所以记住光，闪电。

segments.en: Light is the light that comes down from the sky, lightning.
segments.zh: 光是从天而降的光，闪电。

segments.en: And thunderstorms are just those loud noises that the lightning makes.
segments.zh: 雷暴只是闪电发出的那些响亮的噪音。

segments.en: So usually with thunderstorms, we have very heavy rain.
segments.zh: 所以通常在雷暴的情况下，我们有非常大的雨。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And that's why it's different from drizzling, which is very light.
segments.zh: 这就是它和 drizzling（毛毛雨）不同的地方——毛毛雨非常小。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now we're talking about water.
segments.zh: 现在我们在谈论水。

segments.en: We have drizzle, we have thunderstorm.
segments.zh: 我们有毛毛雨，我们有雷暴。

segments.en: Now what about a shower?
segments.zh: 现在淋浴怎么办？

segments.en: Because the weatherman said there is a high chance of showers.
segments.zh: 因为天气预报员说阵雨的可能性很大。

segments.en: Well, yes, there's a high chance of showers.
segments.zh: 嗯，是的，阵雨的可能性很大。

segments.en: I take showers every day, thank you very much.
segments.zh: 我每天都洗澡，非常感谢。

segments.en: But that's not the kind of shower we're talking about here, is it?
segments.zh: 但这不是我们在这里谈论的那种淋浴，是吗？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Think about it though.
segments.zh: 不过想想看。

segments.en: It's similar.
segments.zh: 它是相似的。

segments.en: A shower when you wash yourself is water coming down on top of you.
segments.zh: 你洗澡时的 shower，就是水从上方落到你身上。

segments.en: Well, in this case, it's a rain shower.
segments.zh: 好吧，在这种情况下，这是一个阵雨。

segments.en: So it's rain that's happening.
segments.zh: 所以正在下雨。

segments.en: Okay, so it's rain water that's coming down, very similar to the shower that you take in the morning.
segments.zh: 好的，所以雨水正在下降，与您早上洗的淋浴非常相似。

segments.en: The difference though is that a shower is a noun and to rain is a verb.
segments.zh: 不同的是，淋浴是名词，雨是动词。

segments.en: So it will rain tomorrow or we expect showers tomorrow.
segments.zh: 所以明天会下雨，或者我们预计明天会阵雨。

segments.en: Both mean the same thing.
segments.zh: 两者的意思是一样的。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: And well, talking about showers and thunderstorms, there's also another type of water that falls from the sky.
segments.zh: 好吧，说到阵雨和雷暴，还有另一种类型的水从天而降。

segments.en: This is called hail.
segments.zh: 这被称为冰雹。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And hail is difficult to describe because it's like ice, but it's not really.
segments.zh: 冰雹很难描述，因为它就像冰，但它不是真的。

segments.en: It's just usually hard, almost like marbles, like hard balls of rain that come down.
segments.zh: 它通常很硬，几乎像弹珠，像一颗颗硬邦邦的雨球落下来。

segments.en: So it's not snow.
segments.zh: 所以不是雪。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It hurts when it hits you.
segments.zh: 当它击中你时会很痛。

segments.en: Sometimes it's very big, sometimes it's very small, but it's heavy, hard things that come out of the clouds.
segments.zh: 有时它很大，有时它很小，但它是从云里落下来的又重又硬的东西。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So just think about it.
segments.zh: 所以想想就好了。

segments.en: It's very, very similar to ice.
segments.zh: 它与冰非常非常相似。

segments.en: It's the small pieces of ice coming down from the sky.
segments.zh: 这是从天而降的小冰块。

segments.en: So that's hail.
segments.zh: 所以这就是冰雹。

segments.en: Obviously, very different from snow because as we said, it's hard.
segments.zh: 显然，它和雪很不一样，因为正如我们所说，它是硬的。

segments.en: Snow is very soft.
segments.zh: 雪很软。

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: And well, with this type of weather going on in the weekend, the commentator said, wow, that certainly sounds like a dreary Saturday.
segments.zh: 好吧，随着周末这种类型的天气，评论员说，哇，这听起来肯定是一个沉闷的星期六。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Dreary is a great word to describe it.
segments.zh: 沉闷是描述它的好词。

segments.en: So as you can tell, it's going to rain.
segments.zh: 所以你可以看出来，天要下雨了。

segments.en: Dreary is not a good thing.
segments.zh: 沉闷不是一件好事。

segments.en: It's not a happy thing.
segments.zh: 这不是一件快乐的事情。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So something is dreary when it's not very exciting.
segments.zh: 所以当它不是很令人兴奋时，有些东西是沉闷的。

segments.en: It looks like it'll be dull or sad or boring or dark.
segments.zh: 看起来它会变得沉闷、悲伤、无聊或黑暗。

segments.en: Now can you describe a person like this as well?
segments.zh: 现在你能描述一个这样的人吗？

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: He's a very dreary person.
segments.zh: 他是一个非常沉闷的人。

segments.en: He's never optimistic.
segments.zh: 他从不乐观。

segments.en: He's always down and yeah, kind of quiet and sad and down.
segments.zh: 他总是情绪低落，是的，有点安静、悲伤和沮丧。

segments.en: Boring.
segments.zh: 无聊。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's what it means.
segments.zh: 所以这就是它的意思。

segments.en: Something that's boring, not very exciting or very calm.
segments.zh: 无聊、不是很令人兴奋或非常平静的东西。

segments.en: But also dark.
segments.zh: 但也很暗。

segments.en: There's a dark element to it because something is dreary.
segments.zh: 它有一个黑暗的元素，因为有些东西是沉闷的。

segments.en: You know, there's no sunshine.
segments.zh: 你知道，没有阳光。

segments.en: There's no light.
segments.zh: 没有光。

segments.en: There's no optimism.
segments.zh: 没有乐观。

segments.en: So you can say it's a dreary day.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说这是一个沉闷的一天。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Very dreary day today.
segments.zh: 今天非常沉闷的一天。

segments.en: No light, no sunshine.
segments.zh: 没有光，没有阳光。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So we've taken a look at a lot of vocab there.
segments.zh: 所以我们在那里看了很多词汇。

segments.en: Why don't we review what we've just learned and listen to the dialogue again.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不回顾我们刚刚学到的东西，再听一次对话。

segments.en: And those are today's top stories.
segments.zh: 这些是今天的头条新闻。

segments.en: Now let's go to John for the weather.
segments.zh: 接下来请约翰播报天气。

segments.en: John, what does the forecast look like for our weekend travelers?
segments.zh: 约翰，打算周末出游的人会遇上什么天气？

segments.en: I'm afraid we're in for a rough weekend, Mary.
segments.zh: 恐怕我们要度过一个艰难的周末，玛丽。

segments.en: There's a storm system moving through the East Coast.
segments.zh: 有一个风暴系统在东海岸移动。

segments.en: It will be drizzling all day today and there's a 60% chance of thunderstorms this evening.
segments.zh: 今天一整天都会下毛毛雨，今晚有 60% 的可能性出现雷暴。

segments.en: It will be warm and humid all weekend.
segments.zh: 整个周末都会温暖潮湿。

segments.en: In the Midwest, expect strong winds and a low of around 40 degrees.
segments.zh: 中西部地区预计有强风，最低气温在四十度左右。

segments.en: That's pretty chilly for the summer.
segments.zh: 这对夏天来说很冷。

segments.en: Will it rain on Saturday?
segments.zh: 周六会下雨吗？

segments.en: Unfortunately, yes.
segments.zh: 很遗憾，是的。

segments.en: It will be clear early Saturday morning, but there is a high chance of showers and thunderstorms later in the day.
segments.zh: 星期六清晨天气晴朗，但当天晚些时候很可能有阵雨和雷暴。

segments.en: There is a severe thunderstorm warning for some parts of the Southeast.
segments.zh: 东南部的一些地区有严重的雷暴警告。

segments.en: Folks in those areas might see some hail and flooding, especially in areas that have been experiencing record high rainfalls.
segments.zh: 这些地区的人们可能会看到一些冰雹和洪水，尤其是在降雨量创历史新高的地区。

segments.en: That certainly sounds like a dreary Saturday.
segments.zh: 这听起来肯定是一个沉闷的星期六。

segments.en: It gets better on Sunday, though.
segments.zh: 不过，周日会好转。

segments.en: The storm systems move East and the skies will clear up at night.
segments.zh: 风暴系统向东移动，天空将在夜晚晴朗。

segments.en: It will still be rather cool with highs in the low 50s.
segments.zh: 天气仍会比较凉，最高气温在五十度出头。

segments.en: The West Coast will be experiencing some unusually chilly weather, but at least the sun will come out.
segments.zh: 西海岸将经历一些异常寒冷的天气，但至少太阳会出来。

segments.en: I advise weekend travelers to be careful, especially while driving.
segments.zh: 我建议周末旅行者要小心，尤其是在开车时。

segments.en: Back to you, Mary.
segments.zh: 接下来交还给你，玛丽。

segments.en: Thanks, John.
segments.zh: 谢谢，约翰。

segments.en: And there you have it.
segments.zh: 以上就是天气情况。

segments.en: Looks like it's a weekend to stay at home.
segments.zh: 看起来这是一个呆在家里的周末。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We're back.
segments.zh: 我们回来了。

segments.en: So now, we're going to talk a little bit about some phrases that we've chosen for you on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以现在，我们将谈谈我们在流利表达上为您选择的一些短语。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: So when we're talking about forecasts, remember that we're talking about things that aren't certain.
segments.zh: 因此，当我们谈论预测时，请记住我们在谈论不确定的事情。

segments.en: We have to explain that there is a possibility of rain or a possibility of sunshine.
segments.zh: 我们必须解释，有可能下雨或有可能出现阳光。

segments.en: And usually, in the weather report, they will use percentages to describe how likely something is to happen.
segments.zh: 通常，在天气报告中，他们会使用百分比来描述某事发生的可能性。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: The weatherman said there is a 60% chance of thunderstorms.
segments.zh: 天气预报员说，雷暴有 60% 的几率。

segments.en: OK.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So 60% is not very likely, but it's also not unlikely.
segments.zh: 所以 60% 不太可能，但也不是不太可能。

segments.en: It means that it might happen that it rains.
segments.zh: 这意味着可能会下雨。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So as you said, it's a way to measure what the probabilities are.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，这是一种衡量概率的方法。

segments.en: Because imagine if the weatherman says it might rain tomorrow, you're like, well, maybe it really will, or maybe it's very unlikely that it won't, or we don't really know.
segments.zh: 因为想象一下，如果天气预报员说明天可能会下雨，那么，也许它真的会下雨，或者它不太可能不会，或者我们真的不知道。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So for example, if the weatherman says there's a 95% chance of rain tomorrow, do you bring your umbrella?
segments.zh: 例如，如果天气预报员说明天有 95% 的几率下雨，你会带雨伞吗？

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: What if he says there's a 5% chance of rain tomorrow?
segments.zh: 如果他说明天有 5% 的几率下雨怎么办？

segments.en: No.
segments.zh: 不。

segments.en: No.
segments.zh: 不。

segments.en: So you have to think about the probability.
segments.zh: 所以你必须考虑概率。

segments.en: 60%, it's maybe half and half.
segments.zh: 60%，大概是一半一半。

segments.en: But 95%, it's very likely to happen.
segments.zh: 但 95% 的情况很可能发生。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And he also mentioned there's a high chance of thunderstorms, or maybe you can say there's a low chance of hail.
segments.zh: 他还提到雷暴的可能性很大，或者你可以说冰雹的可能性很小。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So he's basically saying, he or she is basically saying, you know, it's possible that this will happen, or it's not likely this will happen.
segments.zh: 所以他基本上是在说，他或她基本上是在说，你知道，这可能会发生，或者这不太可能发生。

segments.en: They're trying to help you out.
segments.zh: 他们正试图帮助你。

segments.en: They can't say this will happen, because they don't know.
segments.zh: 他们不能说这会发生，因为他们不知道。

segments.en: OK.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So the key word for probability here, the key word is chance.
segments.zh: 所以这里表示概率的关键词就是 chance。

segments.en: There is a good chance that it will rain.
segments.zh: 很有可能会下雨。

segments.en: So chance is probability.
segments.zh: 所以 chance 就是概率的意思。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So for example, what's the chance it will rain tomorrow?
segments.zh: 那么，例如，明天下雨的机会有多大？

segments.en: Well, there's a high chance.
segments.zh: 嗯，机会很大。

segments.en: OK.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: OK.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And now when we talk about the degrees, or how warm or cold it is, so we express it in Fahrenheit in some countries, or in other countries in centigrade.
segments.zh: 现在，当我们谈论度数，也就是天气有多热或多冷时，有些国家用华氏度来表示，另一些国家则用摄氏度。

segments.en: Here we talk about 40 degrees Fahrenheit.
segments.zh: 在这里，我们讨论 40 华氏度。

segments.en: But the weatherman also says highs and lows.
segments.zh: 但天气预报员还会说 high 和 low（最高温和最低温）。

segments.en: There's a low of around 40 degrees.
segments.zh: 最低温大约在 40 度。

segments.en: What does he mean, a low?
segments.zh: 他说 a low 是什么意思？

segments.en: This is a really important part of the forecast, because you need to know, will you have to bring a coat tomorrow?
segments.zh: 这是预测中非常重要的部分，因为你需要知道，你明天要带一件外套吗？

segments.en: Is it going to be hot or cold?
segments.zh: 会是热的还是冷的？

segments.en: And so you think about a day, usually during the day at noon, or 1 o'clock in the afternoon, it's the hottest.
segments.zh: 所以你想想一天，通常是在中午的白天，或者下午 1 点，这是最热的。

segments.en: But at night, it's the coldest.
segments.zh: 但在晚上，它是最冷的。

segments.en: And so the low refers to the lowest temperature, and the high refers to the highest temperature.
segments.zh: 所以 low 指的是最低气温，high 指的是最高气温。

segments.en: So for example, in the fall, maybe the highs are 60 degrees, but the lows are 40.
segments.zh: 例如在秋天，最高温可能是 60 度，最低温是 40 度。

segments.en: So you should bring a coat.
segments.zh: 所以你应该带一件外套。

segments.en: OK.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: It means at night, it'll be 40, and during the day, it'll be 60.
segments.zh: 这意味着在晚上，它将是 40，白天，它将是 60。

segments.en: OK.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So we're talking about the highs are the highest temperatures, or the highest number that we'll get, and the lows is the lowest.
segments.zh: 所以我们说的 high 就是最高气温，也就是当天会出现的最高数值，low 则是最低数值。

segments.en: So the weatherman will commonly say, tomorrow we'll experience a high of 32 degrees and a low of 25.
segments.zh: 所以天气预报员通常会说，明天最高温 32 度，最低温 25 度。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's very easy to understand that the temperature during the day will be between these two numbers.
segments.zh: 所以很容易理解白天的温度将在这两个数字之间。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: OK.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And for our last phrase, the weatherman also said that there is a severe thunderstorm warning for some parts of the Southeast.
segments.zh: 对于我们的最后一句话，天气预报员还说，东南部的某些地方有严重的雷暴警告。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So, Marco, this is a really key phrase, because it's telling people about potential danger.
segments.zh: 所以，马可，这是一个非常关键的短语，因为它告诉人们潜在的危险。

segments.en: You know, a thunderstorm can be very dangerous, so you want to stay inside.
segments.zh: 你知道，雷暴可能非常危险，所以你想留在里面。

segments.en: So a severe thunderstorm warning, severe means very, very serious, is something you should pay attention to.
segments.zh: 所以严重的雷暴警告，严重的意思是非常非常严重，是你应该注意的事情。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: But now, the interesting thing is that we can change the noun, in this case, thunderstorm, and we can talk about, for example, a severe tornado warning.
segments.zh: 但现在，有趣的是，我们可以改变名词，在这种情况下，雷暴，我们可以谈论一个严重的龙卷风警告。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So if there's a severe tornado warning, then I really have to pay attention to the weather and be careful not to go outside.
segments.zh: 所以如果有严重的龙卷风警告，那么我真的要注意天气，小心不要出门。

segments.en: Or even a severe flood warning.
segments.zh: 甚至是严重的洪水警告。

segments.en: You need to know that the streets might become flooded and prepare.
segments.zh: 您需要知道街道可能会被洪水淹没并做好准备。

segments.en: So they're saying that there's a very high probability that this might happen, so they're warning you to take precaution.
segments.zh: 所以他们说这很可能发生，所以他们警告你要采取预防措施。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So pay attention to that last one.
segments.zh: 所以要注意最后这一个。

segments.en: And we're going to listen to today's dialogue one more time.
segments.zh: 我们将再听一次今天的对话。

segments.en: We'll be back in a moment to talk a little bit more about the weather.
segments.zh: 我们稍后会回来多谈谈天气。

segments.en: And those are today's top stories.
segments.zh: 这些是今天的头条新闻。

segments.en: Now let's go to John for the weather.
segments.zh: 接下来请约翰播报天气。

segments.en: John, what does the forecast look like for our weekend travelers?
segments.zh: 约翰，打算周末出游的人会遇上什么天气？

segments.en: I'm afraid we're in for a rough weekend, Mary.
segments.zh: 恐怕我们要度过一个艰难的周末，玛丽。

segments.en: There's a storm system moving through the East Coast.
segments.zh: 有一个风暴系统在东海岸移动。

segments.en: It will be drizzling all day today, and there's a 60% chance of thunderstorms this evening.
segments.zh: 今天一整天都会下毛毛雨，今晚有 60% 的可能性出现雷暴。

segments.en: It will be warm and humid all weekend.
segments.zh: 整个周末都会温暖潮湿。

segments.en: In the Midwest, expect strong winds and a low of around 40 degrees.
segments.zh: 中西部地区预计有强风，最低气温在四十度左右。

segments.en: That's pretty chilly for the summer.
segments.zh: 这对夏天来说很冷。

segments.en: Will it rain on Saturday?
segments.zh: 周六会下雨吗？

segments.en: Unfortunately, yes.
segments.zh: 很遗憾，是的。

segments.en: It will be clear early Saturday morning, but there is a high chance of showers and thunderstorms later in the day.
segments.zh: 星期六清晨天气晴朗，但当天晚些时候很可能有阵雨和雷暴。

segments.en: There is a severe thunderstorm warning for some parts of the Southeast.
segments.zh: 东南部的一些地区有严重的雷暴警告。

segments.en: Folks in those areas might see some hail and flooding, especially in areas that have been experiencing record high rainfalls.
segments.zh: 这些地区的人们可能会看到一些冰雹和洪水，尤其是在降雨量创历史新高的地区。

segments.en: That certainly sounds like a dreary Saturday.
segments.zh: 这听起来肯定是一个沉闷的星期六。

segments.en: It gets better on Sunday, though.
segments.zh: 不过，周日会好转。

segments.en: The storm systems move east and the skies will clear up at night.
segments.zh: 风暴系统向东移动，天空将在夜晚晴朗。

segments.en: It will still be rather cool, with highs in the low 50s.
segments.zh: 天气仍会比较凉爽，最高温在 50 度出头。

segments.en: The West Coast will be experiencing some unusually chilly weather, but at least the sun will come out.
segments.zh: 西海岸将经历一些异常寒冷的天气，但至少太阳会出来。

segments.en: I advise weekend travelers to be careful, especially while driving.
segments.zh: 我建议周末旅行者要小心，尤其是在开车时。

segments.en: Back to you, Mary.
segments.zh: 接下来交还给你，玛丽。

segments.en: Thanks, John.
segments.zh: 谢谢，约翰。

segments.en: And there you have it.
segments.zh: 以上就是天气情况。

segments.en: Looks like it's a weekend to stay at home.
segments.zh: 看起来这是一个呆在家里的周末。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So talking about the weather, it always seems like the weatherman is always wrong.
segments.zh: 所以说到天气，似乎天气预报员总是错的。

segments.en: Always.
segments.zh: 总是。

segments.en: It's like the opposite of what should happen.
segments.zh: 这就像应该发生的事情相反。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: But you can't blame them because all they have is a computer and some sensors and they have to guess about the weather and help people figure out what to do.
segments.zh: 但是你不能责怪他们，因为他们只有一台电脑和一些传感器，他们必须猜测天气并帮助人们弄清楚该怎么做。

segments.en: Have you ever experienced anything severe like a hard thunderstorm or maybe a tornado or something like this?
segments.zh: 你有没有经历过任何严重的事情，比如强雷暴或龙卷风或类似的东西？

segments.en: I have, actually, because I'm from Chicago.
segments.zh: 实际上，我有，因为我来自芝加哥。

segments.en: And in America, the middle of the country is called the tornado belt.
segments.zh: 在美国，该国的中部被称为龙卷风带。

segments.en: That means it's a piece of land where tornadoes are very common.
segments.zh: 这意味着它是一片土地，龙卷风很常见。

segments.en: And so in the fall and in the spring, we often have tornadoes.
segments.zh: 所以在秋天和春天，我们经常有龙卷风。

segments.en: And I've been in a couple of tornadoes myself.
segments.zh: 我自己也经历过几次龙卷风。

segments.en: Oh, wow.
segments.zh: 哦，哇。

segments.en: Have you seen them?
segments.zh: 你见过它们吗？

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: Is it amazing to see?
segments.zh: 看到它是不是很震撼？

segments.en: They're very scary.
segments.zh: 它们非常可怕。

segments.en: You're always running inside and locking yourself in the basement.
segments.zh: 你总是往屋里跑，把自己锁在地下室。

segments.en: It's very important to protect yourself in a tornado because it's very dangerous around the area of the tornado because the wind is so strong that trucks and cars and telephone poles and big, big heavy objects can fly through the air and hurt people.
segments.zh: 在龙卷风中保护自己非常重要，因为龙卷风周围区域非常危险，风大得能把卡车、汽车、电线杆以及又大又重的物体卷到空中，伤到人。

segments.en: And that's how most of the damage happens.
segments.zh: 这就是大多数伤害发生的方式。

segments.en: Okay, so this is interesting because a tornado is also considered a natural disaster.
segments.zh: 好吧，这很有趣，因为龙卷风也被认为是自然灾害。

segments.en: But it's a weather phenomenon, whereas earthquakes are a natural disaster, but it's not part of the weather.
segments.zh: 但这是一种天气现象，而地震是自然灾害，但它不是天气的一部分。

segments.en: No, yeah, you're right.
segments.zh: 不，是的，你是对的。

segments.en: It's not something that it sweeps in and it leaves.
segments.zh: 它不是那种席卷而来又离开的东西。

segments.en: Like a flood, for example, all of the rain will come down and it will create a flood.
segments.zh: 例如，就像洪水一样，所有的雨都会降下来，它会造成洪水。

segments.en: An earthquake is a natural disaster that's not weather related.
segments.zh: 地震是与天气无关的自然灾害。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, interesting thing.
segments.zh: 好吧，有趣的事情。

segments.en: Maybe some of our listeners that live in a very cold area have experienced a heavy snowstorm.
segments.zh: 也许我们生活在非常寒冷地区的一些听众经历了一场暴风雪。

segments.en: Like a blizzard.
segments.zh: 像暴风雪。

segments.en: Like a blizzard.
segments.zh: 像暴风雪。

segments.en: Or maybe people in a tropical area have experienced a hurricane.
segments.zh: 或者也许热带地区的人经历过飓风。

segments.en: So let us know if you've ever been in one of these weather related phenomenons.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您曾经遇到过这些与天气相关的现象之一，请告诉我们。

segments.en: And also if you have any comments or questions, we're always at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 此外，如果您有任何意见或问题，我们始终在 Englishpod.com。

segments.en: We hope to see you guys there.
segments.zh: 希望到时候见到大家。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Thanks for listening.
segments.zh: 感谢收听。
